versions.name: Save
versions.text: At the start of every other turn, add a random Lost Soul to your hand.

versions.name: SAVE
versions.text: Whenever a monster dies (except Lost Souls), increase the counter by 1. Turn end: If you can, spend 7 counters to summon the next Lost Soul at 1/1, or 2/2 stats if you have 10 or less HP. Lost Soul order: Lost Alphys > Lost Papyrus > Lost Undyne > Lost Toriel > Lost Asgore > Lost Sans > Loop back to Lost Alphys.

versions.name: Save
versions.text: Whenever a monster dies (except Lost Souls), increase the counter by 1. Turn end: Spend 7 counters to summon the next Lost Soul with 1/1 base stats. If your board is full, trigger its Dust effect instead. Lost Soul order: Lost Alphys > Lost Papyrus > Lost Undyne > Lost Toriel > Lost Asgore > Lost Sans > Loop back to Lost Alphys.

versions.name: Save
versions.text: Whenever a monster dies (except Lost Souls), increase the counter by 1. Turn end: Spend 8 counters to summon the next Lost Soul with 1/1 base stats. If your board is full, trigger its Dust effect instead. Lost Soul order: Lost Alphys > Lost Papyrus > Lost Undyne > Lost Toriel > Lost Asgore > Lost Sans > Loop back to Lost Alphys.

versions.name: Save
versions.text: After a monster dies (except Lost Souls), gain counters equal to its cost. If it's Generated or an enemy, gain counters equal to half its cost instead (rounded up). Turn end: Spend 20 counters to summon the next Lost Soul with 1/1 base stats. If your board is full, trigger its Dust instead. Lost Soul order: Lost Alphys > Lost Papyrus > Lost Undyne > Lost Toriel > Lost Asgore > Lost Sans > Loops back to Lost Alphys.
